authorized_by: PI direction 2026-09-18: A is the guardrail / already-good reference; B is the repair target. Do not spend n≈300 proving dual positive gain under the symmetric classifier.
supersedes_for_successor_work: COMPOSITION_SELECTOR_TWO_FEATURE_AMENDMENT.json (suspended; may be revived only by a later freeze that re-authorizes it under an asymmetric criterion)

prior_sealed_context.oracle: PYQUATICUS_4V4_ORACLE_COMPOSITION_RESULT.json (NO_ORACLE_COMPOSITION_CONFIRMATION; B gate strong, A LCB exactly 0)

RESEARCH_QUESTION: Can observable pressure provide a conservative B-trigger that defaults to the A-safe composition 2A/2D, switches to 4A/0D only under strong B-like evidence, substantially detects B-like states, and rarely triggers harmful 4A/0D under Pole A?

ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE.boxed: help B substantially while not breaking A
ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE.A_role: guardrail / preservation / integrity control — already good; not a second patient
ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE.B_role: repair target — large composition effect already measured

WHY_ASYMMETRIC_NOT_SYMMETRIC.false_B_on_A: dangerous — switches A from good 2A/2D into 4A/0D, which confirmation measured as Delta_A=-0.3125
WHY_ASYMMETRIC_NOT_SYMMETRIC.missed_B_on_B: unfortunate but leaves B at the old composition longer; B still has +0.6875 headroom when correctly triggered
WHY_ASYMMETRIC_NOT_SYMMETRIC.consequence: Optimize under a hard A false-positive constraint; maximize B detection. Do not minimize pooled misclassification.

SELECTOR_SHAPE.inputs: only the declared observable feature dict; never pole/genome/outcome (same anti-leak architecture as V1)
SELECTOR_SHAPE.trigger_to_4A0D: only when the online statistic exceeds the frozen high threshold under the frozen hysteresis/dwell rule
SELECTOR_SHAPE.return_to_2A2D: when evidence falls back below the lower hysteresis bound after dwell, or at episode start
SELECTOR_SHAPE.feature_family_authorized_now: the already-selected radius-4 blue-flag pressure count P_blue, recomputed per tick with a trailing window. A second feature is NOT required for this freeze; if used later it must be under a separate amendment that keeps the asymmetric criterion.
SELECTOR_SHAPE.numbers_deferred: exact W, threshold, hysteresis, dwell are NOT inherited from the symmetric calibration RESULT. They are re-selected under the asymmetric criterion below on calibration traces, then locked before any outcome episode.

ASYMMETRIC_CALIBRATION_PROCEDURE.data_calibration: reuse smoke-family traces already collected for selector work (99900101-99900116 both poles, fixed 2A_2D) — outcome-blind; no win/score fields
ASYMMETRIC_CALIBRATION_PROCEDURE.data_validation: fresh disjoint smoke block never used for this operating-point selection — allocate next free smoke pair (e.g. 99900401-99900416) at execution time; report the actual block in the RESULT

grid.note: W=120 added because the symmetric stage found the regime difference is slow/aggregate; still one bounded grid, not an open safari

ASYMMETRIC_CALIBRATION_PROCEDURE.per_config_threshold_rule_declared_befor: For each (W,m,d), scan candidate thresholds on the windowed statistic. Retain only configs whose A-side false-positive tick rate (fraction of Pole-A ticks classified as 4A_0D) is <= max_A_FP_tick_rate. Among survivors, maximize B-side true-positive tick rate (fraction of Pole-B ticks classified as 4A_0D). Tie-break: minimum mean switches/episode on A; then prefer d=4 (macro-commit horizon); then smallest W.

max_A_FP_tick_rate.justification: Confirmation shows full-time 4A/0D on A costs about 0.31 win rate versus 2A/2D. A 10% A-tick false-positive budget is a conservative preservation band: rough linear exposure ~0.03 win rate if harm scaled by exposure, well below that measured full switch cost. This number is frozen before scoring; it is not retuned after seeing the grid.

held_out_report: fraction of A episodes with any 4A0D tick
fraction of B episodes whose dominant composition is 4A0D
ASYMMETRIC_CALIBRATION_PROCEDURE.calibration_pass_rule: held-out A FP tick rate <= 0.10 AND held-out B dominant-composition = 4A0D on at least 0.50 of B episodes. If fail: seal NO_CONSERVATIVE_B_TRIGGER and stop — do not spend outcome seeds.
ASYMMETRIC_CALIBRATION_PROCEDURE.outcome_blind: no score/win/reward/return/draw in calibration or held-out scoring; pole labels only for FP/TP accounting

OUTCOME_EXPERIMENT_IF_CALIBRATION_PASSES.n_note: Do NOT auto-inflate to ~300 for an A positive-gain proof. B's measured composition effect is large; A is a regression guardrail. If A preservation is noisy at n=64, report underpowered preservation, do not silently retarget.

gates.B_improvement_required: STATE_B_TRIGGER minus FIXED_2A2D blue win-rate LCB95 > 0 on Pole B
gates.A_regression_tolerance: FIXED_2A2D minus STATE_B_TRIGGER blue win-rate (A harm) has UCB95 <= tau_A_harm

tau_A_harm.meaning: A may not be shown to improve; it must not be shown to degrade by more than 0.10 win rate at the UCB95 under the selector versus its safe fixed 2A/2D control

decision_labels.B_TRIGGER_CONFIRMED_A_PRESERVED: B gate passes and A harm UCB95 <= 0.10
decision_labels.B_IMPROVED_A_REGRESSED: B gate passes but A harm exceeds tolerance — selector helps B but breaks the guardrail; not a promotion

CONTRACTS_BEFORE_OUTCOME_SEEDS: C1_NO_REGIME_LEAK (identical declared features => identical composition across poles)
C2_DEFAULT_IS_2A2D at episode start and under below-threshold evidence

not_authorized: n≈300 dual positive-gain outcome run under the symmetric classifier
retuning max_A_FP_tick_rate or tau_A_harm after seeing calibration or outcome numbers
treating Pole A as a second repair target

SEQUENCING_LOCK: 2. Implement asymmetric calibration only (no outcome seeds)
4. If PASS: run C1-C5, allocate fresh exploratory seeds, run outcome arms
claim_ceiling: Even B_TRIGGER_CONFIRMED_A_PRESERVED establishes only that a conservative scripted B-trigger helps B without breaking A under these two frozen opponents at 4v4. It does not authorize PPO, learned coordination, or 6v6.
